name: Giovanni Trovato
title: Senior Mobile / Platform Engineer
subtitle: iOS · Android · CI/CD · Mobile Device Management
availability: EU citizen · unrestricted German work authorization · available immediately; released from duties following an operational redundancy (employment contract ends November 2026)
profile: Senior mobile engineer with more than 11 years of experience building native iOS and Android products, including eight years in enterprise mobility and device management. Technical owner of an iOS MDM client for six years, serving hundreds of corporate customers and tens of thousands of managed devices. Strong in Swift, SwiftUI, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, automated testing, CI/CD, code signing and production releases.

relevant_experience.title: Mobile Software Engineer / Technical Owner, iOS & Android
relevant_experience.summary: Enterprise mobility and device management (MDM, secure printing) in a mobile team of 3–7 engineers.
highlights: Expanded the Android test suite to ~4,800 tests and raised UI-test coverage from 15% to 82%, while cutting CI test runtime by 75% (32 to 8 minutes) to give the team same-hour merge feedback.

Technical owner of the Cortado MDM iOS client for six years from its first commit — owned architecture, release decisions and code review across the mobile team, coordinating delivery with product, QA and backend.

Led annual iOS compatibility work and adoption of Dynamic Island, Live Activities, Siri and App Intents; also led the Swift 6 concurrency and iOS 26 migrations while retaining support for older devices.
Migrated the Android device-management client from XML layouts to Jetpack Compose across nearly every screen, including kiosk mode, adding unit tests alongside each migrated screen.

Owned the GitLab CI/CD and Fastlane pipelines for both platforms — pipeline design, GitLab runners, certificates and provisioning profiles, automated versioning, TestFlight and Play Store staged rollout — and automated iOS signing end to end, removing a recurring manual release blocker.

Built the shared mobile test and build infrastructure: Robolectric unit-test harness needing no emulator, reusable ViewModel test infrastructure, a coverage dashboard, and SBOM generation wired into CI for supply-chain compliance.
Standardised AI-assisted planning, test generation and code-review workflows across three mobile repositories, packaging shared guidance so the whole team could use them consistently.

Delivered the iOS print and share extensions for ezeep MobilePrint and the admin-portal authentication layer with Google Sign-In; then expanded into Android ownership within months, maintaining uninterrupted delivery across both platforms.

relevant_experience.title: Mobile Developer
relevant_experience.summary: B2B sales-automation platform for enterprise field sales teams.
highlights: Built native iOS and Android features with an offline-first architecture, keeping field sales teams productive without connectivity.
Created a reusable UI component library and led a UI/UX redesign of the mobile clients, reducing duplicate implementation work across new screens.
Resolved production defects and performance issues for enterprise customers across iOS (Swift, Objective-C) and Android (Java) with REST back ends.

relevant_experience.title: Mobile Developer Intern
relevant_experience.summary: Built production Android augmented-reality applications for manufacturing and automotive clients using Java, Vuforia and Wikitude.
